system.description:
You shape dirt and stone according to your will.

Choose a 1 cubic space of rock or earth within 10 spaces. You can move that earth or rock to an adjacent space or lift it up to 1 space above the ground.

Alternatively, you can carefully sculpt earth or rock while the spell is active, such as writing in dirt, or carving a tool.

Your control over the earth lasts until the start of your next turn, after which it falls or settles where you have left it.

While this spell is active, you can use an Action to move earth again, selecting the same target or a new target as you wish. If you select a new target, you relinquish control over the previous target.

Each extra success extends the duration of your control by +1 round.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.RTzNfMqXMLi7V2e9]{Shape Earth}
